map.年金现值计算器（经济学） 使用指南: Annuity Present Value Calculator (Economics) User Guide
map.输入每期期末收款 PMT、期数 N 与每期利率 i，按折现计算等额年金的当前价值: Enter the end-of-period payment PMT, the number of periods N and the periodic rate i, and compute the present value of the annuity by discounting, for annuity insurance and installment valuation.
map.i=0 时退化为 PMT×N。: At i=0 it degenerates to PMT x N.
map.每期期末等额收款 PMT、共 N 期、每期利率 i 的年金现值。: Present value of an annuity with equal end-of-period payment PMT, N periods in total and periodic rate i.
map.贷款估值：录入每期还款与利率，算贷款现值（本金）。: Loan valuation: enter each payment and the rate to compute the present value of the loan (the principal).
map.养老金现估：对定期领取算当前需储备。: Pension present value: for periodic withdrawals, compute what must be reserved today.
map.教学演示：演示期限越长、利率越低现值越高。: Teaching demo: shows that a longer horizon and a lower rate both raise the present value.
Example: withdrawing 1000 per month at a monthly rate of 0.5% over 12 periods gives PV = 1000 x (1 - 1.005^-12)/0.005 = about 11,562 CNY.
map.由边际消费倾向求税收乘数: Tax multiplier from the marginal propensity to consume
map.普通年金期末收，期初年金现值多乘(1+i)，略高。结果仅作经济学教学与快速测算参: An ordinary annuity pays at the end of the period, while a due annuity is usually multiplied by (1+i) in present value, so it is slightly higher. map.月供对应的现值即贷款本金，利率与期限决定月供水平。结果仅作经济学教学与快速测算参: The present value of the payments is the loan principal, and the rate and term determine the payment level. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation reference only, and do not constitute investment advice or a policy basis; for anything involving forecasts or empirical estimates, defer to authoritative statistics and textbooks.
map.须与收付同频的期利率，年息转月息用月利率，别混。结果仅作经济学教学与快速测算参考: It must use a periodic rate consistent with the payment frequency; convert an annual rate to a monthly one for monthly payments and do not mix them.
